purpose: Physical conservation-residual gate used by the cross-solver frame. A case whose residual exceeds the tolerance for its solver family is marked conservation_fail and is excluded from cross-solver comparison: comparing against a non-conserving run measures the failure mode, not the discretisation difference.

missing_policy.note: WITHHELD means the artifact does not record the residual, so no conservation claim can be made; WARN means the surviving residuals pass but at least one is unmeasured.
